 New York 2026 Election Results
 We're tracking the races for governor, comptroller, attorney general, all 26 of New York's US House seats, all 213 seats in the State Legislature, and 37 State Supreme Court seats. Live results and updates begin when the polls close at 9 pm.
 14.5% of New York's registered voters voted early in person through Nov. 1
